title: About Us
description: Our mission, teaching philosophy, and the people behind Osman Academy.
html:
About Us

Knowledge. Wisdom. Human judgment.

We help people understand AI and put it to work thoughtfully, through detailed e-books and practical courses.

Our purpose

Learning that starts with people.

Our mission

Teach the knowledge and wisdom to build AI systems that align with human interests.

Our vision

A more peaceful and prosperous world, where people use AI with understanding and sound judgment.

Our objectives

Explain concepts clearly, connect learning to practical work, and help learners explain what they understand in their own words.

How we teach

Our Teaching Philosophy

We believe the most effective way to learn AI is to own the learning process: stay curious, do the thinking yourself, and never let AI think for you. As you learn, ask yourself one question: could I teach what I just learned to my family or friends? If yes, move on. If not, keep working until you can. To help you get there, we built our curriculum on two foundations, Knowledge and Wisdom, taught through a 4-step cognitive process. Knowledge comes from the coursework: lessons, guides, and practice. Wisdom comes from the doing: role-play, assignments, and projects.

01
Knowledge

Learn

Watch the lesson, then clarify the concept with reading and visual guides until the idea is solid.

02
Knowledge

Practice

Check what you recall, then rehearse the skill in a guided, low-risk setting with real feedback.

03
Wisdom

Apply

Put judgment to the test in role-play scenarios and realistic assignments — the kind of decisions you'd actually face outside the course.

04
Wisdom

Master

Prove it through a capstone project that puts everything you've learned, knowledge and wisdom both, to work.

Discover the Team who follow this philosophy
Get to know us

About Our Team

Osman Academy is a unique family initiative, and each of us covers a different piece of what it takes to teach AI well. Osman built production-grade AI systems and handles the technology. Firdous does the instructional design, so it actually sticks. Bari has run business operations and knows how AI gets used on the ground. Same family, three fields, one goal: getting you AI-fluent.
